sources.title: All are Worth Words: A ViT Backbone for Diffusion Models
sources.snippet: Vision transformers (ViT) have shown promise in various vision tasks while the U-Net based on a convolutional neural network (CNN) remains dominant in diffusion models. We design a simple and general ViT-based architecture (named U-ViT) for image generation with diffusion models.
